answer: Stop fake agents with a cedar, a ledge, and a wharf. Every identity must grow a cedar: an attestation tree that matures only after epochs of honest acts, so a fresh clone has no history to stand on. Each new cedar docks at a wharf, moored for a challenge window where anyone can prove fraud. Admission is a narrow ledge: one new cedar per funder per epoch. A cedar bond is priced by how many cedar trees share one funder, so N clones lock N² times the base stake, and one proven fraud fells the whole stand on that root. Honest agents grow one tree; a farm pays quadratically and loses the stand.
